# Prateek Sunal

> Prateek Sunal is a software engineer in Bengaluru, India. Portfolio at prateek.sunal.in with hacker, editorial, and résumé views. Contact: prateek@sunal.in.

Blog posts are static pages; each post’s markdown lives alongside its HTML under `/blog/<slug>/`.
